source_text: The Orlune H40 regional railcar is offered in the H40-2 two-car configuration. The complete trainset is 39.8 m long, 2.90 m wide and 3.85 m high. It accommodates up to 124 passengers, including 96 seated and 28 standing. Maximum speed is 120 km/h. The H40-2 is intended for 1,067 mm gauge routes and uses hydrogen fuel-cell propulsion with battery energy storage.
